Title: Almost Human, Except When It Matters: VoxParity and the Decisions a Voice Should Change
Author: Bhavik Mangla
Description: VoxParity tests whether voice agents act on what they hear: in 183 scenarios the words stay fixed while the audio (tone of voice, background sound, a second voice) changes the correct tool call. It evaluates 28 systems with judge-free scoring against a words-only cascade baseline.
